current_difficulty_reason: The final connected-graph selection is formal once the disconnected expectation is supplied, so it is not the difficulty evidence by itself. Sections2–3 construct the weight-dependent conjugated Heisenberg operators and evaluate their vacuum expectations in the infinite-matrix realization, producing the operator and edge weights used in Proposition3.6. Those new computations and formal-sector coefficient controls remain required after standard Fock-space foundations are allowed.
